Carlos (Sales): New POC request from BeaconBank. 3-week pilot, VPC-only, CMK, no external logs. They estimate 4k DAU, 4 calls/user/day, avg 100 tokens/call. Need a tight cost band and clear SOW success criteria.
Nina (SE): Token calc: 4k * 4 * 100 = 1,600,000 tokens/day -> ~48M tokens/month. For 3 weeks that's ~11.2M tokens. Baseline traffic they expect: 150 RPS, short marketing bursts to 800 RPS.
Omar (Infra Eng): Throughput estimate: baseline 150*100 = 15k tok/s. Burst 800*100 = 80k tok/s. GPU ballpark: mid GPU ~3k tok/s, large ~7k tok/s. Baseline needs ~5 mid GPUs or ~3 large; bursts require many ephemeral GPUs.
Nina (SE): Cost-control options: 1) sample traffic (20-30%) for first week, 2) prefix/KV caching for templated prompts, 3) pre-filter classifier to short-circuit low-value prompts, 4) use smaller model for non-critical flows.
Priya (Security): Confirm VPC peering, CMK with customer-managed key, and audit export to their S3 for 90 days. Questionnaire requested within 48 hours.
Omar (Infra Eng): Cost sketch (cloud-equivalents): large GPU ~$45/hr, mid GPU ~$12/hr. Recommend hybrid: reserve 1 large GPU for critical path (12h/day) + burst mid-GPU spot pool + hosted overflow for extreme spikes. For 3 weeks infra ~$6k-$9k depending on burst usage; platform & token fees ~$2-$4k. Total ~ $8k-$13k.
Carlos (Sales): Their budget target is $10k. That range could work if we enforce sampling and overflow.
Nina (SE): Draft success criteria for SOW:
1) Latency: p95 <= 700ms on staged 25% sample during week 2.
2) Reliability: e2e error rate <= 1.5%.
3) Quality: >= 90% on a 150-prompt eval (automated metrics + 15 manual spot checks).
4) Cost cap: pilot total <= $10k unless they opt into premium tier.
5) Security: VPC peering, CMK validated, no data egress.
Omar (Infra Eng): Runbook & timings: network/KMS approval 2 business days, reserved infra provisioning 1-2 days, autoscale + canary 2-3 days. Load test we'll run:
```
heyload --rps 150 --burst-rps 800 --burst-duration 120 --duration 10m --payload=beacon_prompts.json
```
Nina (SE): Example eval item we'll use in the 150-prompt set:
```
{"prompt": "Summarize this transaction: acct 7777 charge $14.50 order #229", "expected_intent": "explain_charge"}
```
AllocatorBot: reservation_request created: beacon-poc-207 (status: pending_network)
Carlos (Sales): I'll send the proposal with the Lean (sample+cache) plan as default and a Premium low-latency option. I'll also request the security questionnaire back in 48 hours. Target kickoff ~12 business days pending approvals. :thumbsup:
